source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Dom,

Could you provide a total quote for 96-102 pages?

Thanks!
Nate

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Using what I had already written, I worked through the numbers.

First, could you clarify whether the request is for 102 pages of screenplay or 102 pages of comic? My completed work produced an approximate screenplay-to-comic conversion of roughly 3:1.

If part 4 is approximately the same length as episode 1, then parts 1 through 4 should amount to around 54-60 comic pages. I could complete that scope for $625 with a turnaround of 5 weeks. If I can reuse 18 pages from the sample script with only light revision and page reflowing, I could reduce that price to $475.

The larger option of 96-102 comic pages is also possible, but it would require covering more of the story, presumably through episode 5 or 6. For that scope, I propose $1125 with a 7-week turnaround. With 18 pages of the sample script reused, the price would instead be $950.

Please let me know which option is closer to what you have in mind and whether these terms work for you.

Thanks,
Dom

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Thank you very much. At that rate, I can devote more time to finding the best way to present everything instead of adhering so closely to the screenplay.

Should I begin in three weeks, or wait until you explicitly say "go?"

I can commit to scripting 96-102 comic pages. After reviewing the next five episodes and the novel, I’ll determine how much of the story fits within that space. While doing so, should I pace the adaptation with the eventual remainder of the story in mind? In other words, should this section feel self-contained, or should it leave readers asking, "What’s next?"

Thanks,
Dom

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Sorry for the confusion. I’m still hoping to obtain funding, and the sample I paid for was part of that effort. The project will move forward if the campaign succeeds, but I’m not requesting any additional work from you yet. If you prefer to withdraw from future involvement, please tell me as soon as possible.
